svg.title: An island of white houses, drawn as a toy-brick model
svg.desc: A stepped island with white Cycladic houses, a windmill, a wind turbine, three figures, gulls, a pelican on the pier and a boat. Each part links to a section of the site: the sea to marine work, the island, its gulls and the pelican to ecology and evolution, the figures to social and economic systems, the turbine to sustainability, and the houses to the pages.
